promotions.title: 4 Systems, One Home
promotions.summary: CUCKOO's current featured promotion covers their four main product categories: water purifier, air purifier, bidet, and massage chair. Products in each category are available at reduced sale pricing with flexible monthly rental plans.
promotions.productName: Water Purifier + Air Purifier + Bidet + Massage Chair
promotions.bestFor: Homeowners outfitting a new home or upgrading multiple rooms at once
promotions.whyItStandsOut: Covers all four major categories in one rental program. Each system is installed and serviced under its own CUCKOO plan, with no bundled lock-in required.

promotions.title: FIT Water Purifier
promotions.summary: The FIT Water Purifier (CP-MN031W) is currently listed at $509, reduced from its regular price of $599. A compact countertop unit with self-cleaning technology and hot, cold, and room-temperature dispensing. Rental plans start at $19.99/mo under a Self Care plan.
promotions.bestFor: First-time renters and small households looking for an entry-level purifier with simple maintenance
promotions.whyItStandsOut: $90 off the regular price, with the lowest available monthly rental rate in the CUCKOO lineup. Self-cleaning means no manual filter contact.

promotions.title: Bidet Promotion
promotions.summary: CUCKOO is currently running a promotional offer on their bidet lineup. The Inspure Instant Heating Premium Bidet includes instant heating, a 3-in-1 stainless steel self-cleaning nozzle, air drying, and remote control. Available for both elongated and round toilet seats.
promotions.bestFor: Homeowners upgrading their bathroom who want instant heating and professional installation
promotions.whyItStandsOut: Includes professional installation through CUCKOO's service network. The stainless steel 3-in-1 nozzle self-cleans before and after every use.

promotions.title: Room Care Smart Air Purifier
promotions.summary: The Room Care Smart Air Purifier (CAC-C1020FW) is currently listed at $594, down from $699. Features real-time 6-color LED air quality indicators, automatic room-size detection, dust sensor, and a baby mode. Runs continuously with quiet operation.
promotions.productName: CUCKOO Room Care Smart Air Purifier
promotions.bestFor: Households with allergy concerns, pets, or young children
promotions.whyItStandsOut: $105 off the regular price. The 6-color real-time air quality display gives instant visibility into what your air purifier is actually doing.

promotions.title: Renature 3D Massage Chair
promotions.summary: The Renature 3D Massage Chair (CMS-D10SLGB) is currently listed at $4,499, reduced from $5,499. A full-body 3D massage chair with 12 automatic massage modes, foot rollers, body scan, zero-gravity positioning, Bluetooth speakers, and remote control.
promotions.bestFor: Homeowners who want a full-body recovery tool at home without a commercial gym membership
promotions.whyItStandsOut: $1,000 off the regular price. Monthly rental option at $89/mo over 5 years means no large upfront purchase required.

promotions.title: Tower MAX Air Purifier
promotions.summary: The Tower MAX Air Purifier (CAC-D2020FW) is listed at $849, reduced from $999. A 360-degree purification tower with 8,200 air filtration pores, effective for large rooms and pet dander. All-in-one filter design simplifies replacement.
promotions.bestFor: Larger living spaces, open-plan homes, or households with pets
promotions.whyItStandsOut: $150 off the regular price. The 360-degree design means no dead spots in air coverage, suitable for rooms up to the unit's rated square footage.

promotions.title: Micro-Bubble Cleanser
promotions.summary: The Micro-Bubble Cleanser (CWS-AO201W) is listed at $509, down from $599. A shower-integrated microbubble system that generates nanobubbles to cleanse skin and hair without chemical additives. Installs inline with your existing showerhead.
promotions.bestFor: Anyone with sensitive skin, dry hair, or looking to reduce chemical exposure in their daily shower routine
promotions.whyItStandsOut: $90 off. Works without changing your shower routine — installs inline and requires no specialized maintenance.
